what_this_is: The Workshop row for the record-ai-work-tokens folder: reads the person's Claude Code transcripts from their byte cursors and returns the usage rows and the SQL that records them. It writes nothing; the daily recipe runs the SQL with tool:run-sql-in-my-database.

payload.label: Record how many AI tokens each transcript used (runs on your computer)
payload.job: Read new Claude Code transcript lines since the last run and return usage rows and SQL for the measurement tables
